notFound.name: Page not found
notFound.body: The page with the URL {query} does not exist. Maybe you were looking for something else?

badRequest.name: Bad request
badRequest.body: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax: {message}

internalServerError.name: Something went wrong
internalServerError.body: The server encountered an internal error and was unable to complete your request. Please try again later.

unauthorized.name: Unauthorized
unauthorized.body: It seems you are not authorized to access this page. Maybe you forgot to bribe the gatekeeper?

serviceUnavailable.heading: Maintenance in progress
serviceUnavailable.body: We are busy feeding the server hamsters, but this usually does not take long. Please try again in a few minutes.
